references.title: Choosing an organization name
references.content: Use the legal or operating name teammates will recognize. You can change the display name later.

references.title: Naming the first workspace
references.content: Use a short name for the team or program that will own these forms and responses.

references.title: Production or sandbox
references.content: Choose Sandbox for integration testing. Choose Production only when people should submit real information.

references.title: Tenant provisioning context
references.content: Resolve organization ownership and environment eligibility before proposing setup values.

references.title: Name on the receipt
references.content: Enter the name you want the receiving organization to see on this submission and its receipt.

references.title: Where the receipt goes
references.content: Use an address you can access. The submission receipt and any follow-up notices will use it.

references.title: What to include
references.content: Describe the request clearly enough for the organization to route it. Do not include passwords or payment card numbers.

references.title: Submission notices
references.content: Notices cover this submission, including its receipt and status. They do not subscribe you to marketing.

references.title: Response handling context
references.content: Never infer consent. Preserve the person supplied email and response text exactly.
